cases.name: plain
cases.systemd:
[Unit]
Description=LocalBase gateway
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=exec
ExecStart="/usr/local/bin/local-base" "--root" "/lb-golden/u/.local/share/local-base" "serve"
WorkingDirectory=/lb-golden/u/.local/share/local-base
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s
KillMode=mixed
KillSignal=SIGTERM
TimeoutStopSec=15s
UMask=0077
Environment="LOCALBASE_SERVICE_ID=com.localbase.gateway.aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
Environment="LOCALBASE_SERVICE_TOKEN=6f1c2c3e-8a7b-4c1d-9e2f-0123456789ab"
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=journal

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target

<dict>
  <key>Label</key><string>com.localbase.gateway.aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa</string>
  <key>Program</key><string>/usr/local/bin/local-base</string>
  <key>ProgramArguments</key>
  <array>
    <string>/usr/local/bin/local-base</string>
    <string>--root</string>
    <string>/lb-golden/u/.local/share/local-base</string>
    <string>serve</string>
  </array>
  <key>WorkingDirectory</key><string>/lb-golden/u/.local/share/local-base</string>
  <key>RunAtLoad</key><true/>
  <key>KeepAlive</key><true/>
  <key>ExitTimeOut</key><integer>15</integer>
  <key>Umask</key><integer>63</integer>
  <key>ProcessType</key><string>Interactive</string>

  <dict>

  <key>StandardOutPath</key><string>/dev/null</string>
  <key>StandardErrorPath</key><string>/lb-golden/u/.local/share/local-base/logs/service-stderr.log</string>
